analysis_cirs.ac:
* Auto-generated SPICE netlist - Two Switch Forward DC-DC Converter
* Auto-grounded net 4 due to VIN:-
.options rshunt=1e+12 cshunt=1e-12 reltol=0.01 abstol=1e-09 vntol=1e-05 chgtol=1e-11 gmin=1e-10
.options method=gear maxord=2 trtol=4
.model nmos_model NMOS(Vto=3 Lambda=0.01 Kp=39 Cbd=1n Cbs=1n Cgdo=100p Is=1e-14 Tt=100n Rs=0.01)
.model Dmodel D(Is=1e-12 n=1.1 Rs=0.1 Cjo=5e-12 Tt=1e-08 Bv=200 Ibv=1e-06)
* --- Transformer (parametric, series-R + core loss) ---
.subckt Xfmr P1 P2 S1 S2 params: Lm=100u Ns=3.6 K=0.99 Rwp=0.5 Rws=0.1 Rcore=1e6 Cww=0
Rwp  P1  P1a {Rwp}
Rws  S1  S1a {Rws}
Lp   P1a P2  {Lm}
Ls   S1a S2  {Lm*Ns*Ns}
K1   Lp  Ls  {K}
Rcore P1a P2 {Rcore}
Cww  P1a S1a {Cww}
.ends Xfmr

VIN VIN_src 0 DC 48
RVIN_series VIN_src n0 0.1
VPWM1 n_PWM1_int n1 PULSE(0 15 0 1e-07 1e-07 4.1e-06 1e-05)
RPWM1_drive n_PWM1_int n2 100
VPWM2 n_PWM2_int 0 PULSE(0 15 0 1e-07 1e-07 4.1e-06 1e-05)
RPWM2_drive n_PWM2_int n5 100
VSW1_SENSE n0 n_SW1_dsense 0
MSW1 n_SW1_dsense n2 n1 n1 nmos_model
VSW2_SENSE n3 n_SW2_dsense 0
MSW2 n_SW2_dsense n5 0 0 nmos_model
VD1_SENSE n3 n_D1_sense 0
RD1_SENSE_DAMP n_D1_sense n_D1_damp 0.001
D1 n_D1_damp n0 Dmodel
VD2_SENSE 0 n_D2_sense 0
RD2_SENSE_DAMP n_D2_sense n_D2_damp 0.001
D2 n_D2_damp n1 Dmodel
VT1_SENSE_PRI n1 n_T1_p1_sense 0
VT1_SENSE_SEC n6 n_T1_s1_sense 0
XT1 n_T1_p1_sense n3 n_T1_s1_sense n8 Xfmr Lm=0.0005 Ns=2.5 K=0.99 Rwp=0.5 Rws=0.1 Rcore=1e+06 Cww=0
R_ISO n8 0 1e+08
VD_FWD_SENSE n6 n_D_FWD_sense 0
RD_FWD_SENSE_DAMP n_D_FWD_sense n_D_FWD_damp 0.001
D_FWD n_D_FWD_damp n7 Dmodel
VD_FW_SENSE n8 n_D_FW_sense 0
RD_FW_SENSE_DAMP n_D_FW_sense n_D_FW_damp 0.001
D_FW n_D_FW_damp n7 Dmodel
VL_OUT_SENSE n7 n_L_OUT_sense 0
RL_OUT_ESR n_L_OUT_sense n_L_OUT_ser 0.05
L_OUT n_L_OUT_ser n9 0.0001 IC=0
CL_OUT_par n7 n9 3e-11
RL_OUT_core n7 n9 1e+06
VCout_SENSE n9 n_Cout_sense 0
LCout_ESL n_Cout_sense n_Cout_esl 1e-10
RCout_ESR n_Cout_esl n_Cout_esr 0.02
Cout n_Cout_esr n8 0.00047 IC=0
RCout_LEAK n9 n8 1.6e+07
VR_LOAD_SENSE n9 n_R_LOAD_sense 0
LR_LOAD_PL n_R_LOAD_sense n_R_LOAD_mid 1e-08
R_LOAD n_R_LOAD_mid n8 5

.end

.control
set noaskquit
set nomoremode
set numdgt=9

.endc

linearize
let Vout_avg_diff = v(n9) - v(n8)
meas tran Vout_avg avg Vout_avg_diff from=0.016 to=0.02

let Vout_ripple_vpp_diff = v(n9) - v(n8)
meas tran Vout_ripple_vpp pp Vout_ripple_vpp_diff from=0.016 to=0.02

let VOUT = VOUT_csv_diff
wrdata time_series/tr_reg_VOUT.csv VOUT_csv_diff
let PWM1_gate_diff = v(n2) - v(n1)
wrdata time_series/Gate_PWM1.csv PWM1_gate_diff

* Transient Requirement tr_eff: Efficiency; verify D1/D2 clamp diode loss; measure forward and freewheeling diode conduction

linearize
meas tran Iin_avg avg i(vin) from=0.016 to=0.02
print Iin_avg
meas tran Iout_avg avg i(vr_load_sense) from=0.016 to=0.02
print Iout_avg
let Vout_avg_diff = v(n9) - v(n8)
meas tran Vout_avg avg Vout_avg_diff from=0.016 to=0.02
print Vout_avg
meas tran Vin_avg avg v(n0) from=0.016 to=0.02
print Vin_avg
meas tran Id1_avg avg i(vd1_sense) from=0.016 to=0.02
print Id1_avg
meas tran Id_fwd_avg avg i(vd_fwd_sense) from=0.016 to=0.02
print Id_fwd_avg
meas tran IL_out_rms rms i(vl_out_sense) from=0.016 to=0.02
print IL_out_rms
wrdata time_series/tr_eff_IL_OUT.csv i(vl_out_sense)
let PWM1_gate_diff = v(n2) - v(n1)
wrdata time_series/Gate_PWM1.csv PWM1_gate_diff
wrdata time_series/Gate_PWM2.csv v(n5)
plot i(vl_out_sense) title 'tr_eff_IL_OUT'
plot PWM1_gate_diff title 'Gate_PWM1'
plot v(n5) title 'Gate_PWM2'

* Transient Requirement tr_stress: Switch peak voltage clamped to VIN by D1/D2; verify switches see no more than VIN
tran 4e-07 0.02 0 1e-06 uic
linearize
let Vsw1_max_diff = v(n0) - v(n1)
meas tran Vsw1_max max Vsw1_max_diff from=0.016 to=0.02
print Vsw1_max
meas tran Vsw2_max max v(n3) from=0.016 to=0.02
print Vsw2_max
meas tran Isw1_peak max i(vsw1_sense) from=0.016 to=0.02
print Isw1_peak
let VSW1_csv_diff = v(n0) - v(n1)
let VSW1 = VSW1_csv_diff
wrdata time_series/tr_stress_VSW1.csv VSW1_csv_diff
let PWM1_gate_diff = v(n2) - v(n1)
wrdata time_series/Gate_PWM1.csv PWM1_gate_diff
wrdata time_series/Gate_PWM2.csv v(n5)
plot VSW1_csv_diff title 'tr_stress_VSW1'
plot PWM1_gate_diff title 'Gate_PWM1'
plot v(n5) title 'Gate_PWM2'
.endc
